replication.target_description: Consumer versus individual framing; trust in others conserving water

n.quote: Replication. In the aggregate replication sample (N = 6,608), participants in the consumer condition reported slightly less trust that other people would conserve water (M = 3.92, SD = 1.44) compared with participants in the control condition (M = 4.10, SD = 1.45), t(6606) = 4.93, p = 8.62e -7 , d = 0.12, 95% CI = [0.07, 0.17]. This result is consistent with the hypothesis that people have lower trust in others when they think of those others as consumers rather than as individuals. The overall effect size was much smaller than in the original experiment (d = 0.12, 95% CI = [0.07, 0.17], vs. original d = 0.87).
